interactions.description: 阳光洒在校门前，长颈鹿老师正在扫地。
interactions.descriptionEn: Sunshine spills over the school gate, and the giraffe teacher is sweeping the floor.

interactions.dialogue: 老师：早上好呀，小同学～今天看起来精神不错呀！
interactions.dialogueEn: Teacher: Good morning, little student! You look energetic today!

description: 你大声向老师打招呼：「老师早上好」，声音像早晨的阳光一样明亮。
长颈鹿老师笑着回应：「早上好，你的声音真有力量」
她的笑容让空气都变得温暖。
descriptionEn: You greet the teacher loudly: "Good morning, teacher!", your voice as bright as the morning sun.
The giraffe teacher smiles and responds: "Good morning, your voice is so powerful!"
Her smile makes the air feel warm and happy.

description: 老师轻轻牵着你的手，向校园里走去。
她的声音在阳光下轻轻回荡：「一起进去吧。」
descriptionEn: The teacher gently takes your hand and walks toward the campus.
Her voice gently echoes in the sunlight: "Let's go in together."

interactions.dialogue: 老师：看到你的好朋友了吗？
interactions.dialogueEn: Teacher: Have you seen your good friend?

options.textEn: Yes! I'm going to play with him!

options.text: 还没有看到，我先自己玩一会儿
options.textEn: Not yet, I'll play by myself for a while
I don't know, I'm a little nervous
